versions.localizedDescription:
Roam Control 0.9.2 Beta 5 — Build 56

What’s changed:
- Adds bounded location-task registration validation and lifecycle hardening around scheduler setup, cancellation and stale callbacks.
- Adds fixed configuration and registration states to Connection Health diagnostics for relevant scheduler failures.
- Adds optional consent-gated self-hosted anonymous telemetry alongside TelemetryDeck.
- Adds release invariant checks and updated privacy, release and regression documentation.
- Includes Stop & Restore and interrupted-session reliability improvements carried forward from the current beta work.

Validation:
- Final IPA installed successfully through SideStore.
- Fixed-location simulation and Stop & Restore passed on the owner device.
- Self-hosted telemetry consent OFF and ON paths were verified on the final Build 56 candidate.
- Backend ingestion of the new scheduler configuration/registration fields was verified.

Important:
- This build improves scheduler diagnostics and lifecycle handling, but it does not establish that all iOS schedulerRegistration failures are fixed. External validation is still needed on affected devices.
